title: Stable influences of balanced juntas
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and suppose it depends on at most $k$ coordinates, where $k>0$. If the mean of its real-valued sign representation is zero and $0<\delta<1$, then it is not the case that every coordinate has stable influence at parameter $1-\delta$ at most $(1-\delta)^k/k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
$f$ depends on a set of at most $k$ coordinates
The mean of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ is zero
